conflicts.remarks_quote: This complete set of data repeats itself for each spline found in the sketch. For each spline, the array returned contains the number of spline points in the spline, and the X,Y,Z value for each of those points.
conflicts.why: Remarks 说每条样条各重复一组 [N, x,y,z…]；示例按单一 1+N*3 定长取值。多样条草图时实际长度应为 Σ(1+3Ni)，与 1+3ΣNi 不能同时成立。

conflicts.remarks_quote:
The return value is an array of doubles formatted as:

[ [NumSplinePoints, [x, y, z] ], ]
conflicts.why: Remarks 说首元素是本条样条的 NumSplinePoints；示例首元素取自 GetSketchPointsCount2（整草图点数），两者只在单样条草图上巧合相等。
